title: Change an issue's status from the edit dialog (server-driven card relocation)

scenarios.name: The edit dialog exposes a status control pre-set to the current state
Saving a new status relocates the card to that column
No-JS fallback saves the status change

RED.action: Un-@pended the three @us-01 scenarios; authored HTTP-level glue in feature_issue_status_move.rs (reuses board/sign-in/issue-edit-dialog helpers).
RED.fail_for_right_reason: All 3 failed on business assertions (no status <select>; stored state backlog != todo/done) — not import/collection/infra errors.

GREEN.action: Added issues.state to IssueEditRow + issue_edit_view; IssueEditView.state; IssueEditModal.selected_state + status <select> in issue_edit_modal.html; stable id="issue-{key}" on the card render + issue_card.html; EditIssueForm.state; submit_edit now detects a real status change (normalize_state + authz-gated read) and, when changed, reuses change_issue_state (shipped outbox path) and returns the two-op OOB relocation (delete-old + append-to-column); unchanged status keeps the in-place outerHTML replace.
GREEN.reuse: No new store/service method. change_issue_state + edit_issue_details + edit_issue_form reused.

COMMIT.stopping_criterion: 3 behaviors x 2 = 6 unit-test budget; 0 unit tests authored (acceptance drives all behavior port-to-port through the HTTP handler; GREEN was straightforward wiring). Within budget, no parametrize-inflation.
COMMIT.wiring_verification: git diff includes all production files (app handler, views, templates, service, store) — not Fixture Theater.

scope_notes: Slice 02 (drag-and-drop) NOT implemented — the three @us-02 scenarios remain @pending.
One persist path (change_issue_state). No migration. No new store/service method.
